name: householdbot
description: HouseholdBot: an open-source plugin that runs a household's paperwork from a conversation. Files documents, tracks deadlines and renewals, and writes a weekly brief, with approval before anything is written, sent or paid.

plugins.name: householdbot
plugins.description: Runs a household's paperwork from a conversation: files letters, bills, contracts and policies into one record the household owns, tracks deadlines, renewals and cancel-by dates with the country's holidays, and briefs you on the week ahead. Works in English or Polish, from photos, PDFs and pasted messages; connectors are optional. Nothing is written, sent or paid without your approval.
